claims.text: LDA and Gibbs sampling were applied to evaluate ISWC and WWW conference publications from 2013-2017.
The study aimed to discover trends in topics and relationships between LDA topics and paper features.
Gibbs sampling was used for parameter estimation in the LDA model to analyze the publications.
